packDescription: A rugged military laser rifle in chipped olive paint. Instead of bullets it fires a focused beam of light that arrives the instant you pull the trigger: no drop, no lead, no travel time. Each shot hits for 400 and has a chance to set its target on fire. Runs on Laser Battery Packs: load one like a magazine (R swaps in a fresh one from your pack), 40 Wh a shot so about 50 shots each, and recharge them in the game's chargers. Fires about 300 shots a minute with almost no recoil, and makes a sharp electric crack you will learn to love.
author: girthy_mods
